acceptance_criteria.criterion: Running the compiled CLI entry point (node dist/index.js) with a valid config.json starts the HTTP server and logs a success message including the port number.
The staticDir is correctly resolved to gui/public/ relative to the project root using path.resolve(__dirname, '..', 'gui', 'public').
Opening http://localhost:<serverPort> in a browser serves index.html and the full GUI loads.
If the server fails to start (e.g., port in use), an error message is written to stderr and the process exits with code 1.
The existing --verbose flag continues to print configuration details before server startup.
